verdict.rationale: Forter documents a dedicated webhooks system for real-time event notifications (order status, chargeback forwarding, dispute webhooks) that can be configured to notify external services, directly matching the subscribe-to-events story; this is a well-documented first-party capability. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability, and a comprehensive list of subscribable event types/payload schema beyond the examples shown.
